entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to start a return. Order number is VF-92110.
Certainly. Let me just pull that up for you. VF-92110... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit SpinPro cycling shoes. To get this started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue?
They don't fit right. After two classes, they're giving me terrible blisters. I've tried everything, even adjusting the cleats, but it's no use. I just want a refund.
I'm very sorry to hear that. Comfort is key, and getting blisters is the last thing we want for our customers. Let me check the policy for you.
Just tell me yes or no. Can I return them?
Yes, absolutely. I see they were delivered 39 days ago, which is unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can process that full refund for you right now.
Great. So what do I do?

I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to the address on file. You can just print that out, attach it to the original box, and drop it at any FedEx location. And I see you're a VIP member with us. For the inconvenience, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for your next VeloFit purchase.
Oh. Okay, that's good. Appreciate that.
Of course. We value your business. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
Alright, thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
